fields.description: 12-byte fixed header validation stamp. FUN_08011824 copies these 12 default bytes into the write buffer and stores them as EEPROM blocks 0-1; FUN_08011a00 requires all 12 bytes to match the expected defaults before a save is accepted.
fields.evidence: FUN_08011824 copies 0xC bytes into the block 0-1 write buffer then calls FUN_080357dc for blocks 0 and 1; FUN_08011a00 compares all 0xC header bytes against expected defaults and rejects the save on any mismatch. Logical bytes decode to 'BA0CK1UP0ID5'.
fields.name: header_game_stamp

fields.description: Active save-slot selector stored with the header. FUN_08011824 writes 0 for a fresh save; FUN_08011a00 only proceeds when this value is < 2 and derives the slot base block as Div(value,2)*30+2 (block 2 or 32). A live update from the loaded record byte is applied to the RAM copy.
fields.evidence: FUN_08011824 zeroes the u32 at header offset 0xC before writing blocks 0-1 via FUN_080357dc; FUN_08011a00 gates slot loading on this u32 being < 2 and computes the 30-block slot base from it with FUN_080353e8 (SWI Div).
fields.name: active_slot_index

fields.description: Slot 0 toggle byte at record offset +1. On a successful slot validation FUN_08011a00 derives the next toggle value (value+1, wrapping to 0 above 1) and stores it back into the header slot selector copy. Blank (0xFF) on a fresh cart whose slot was never written.
fields.evidence: FUN_08011a00 slot-validation path reads the byte at slot base +1, computes (value+1) with wrap to 0 when above 1, and writes it into the header dword copy.
fields.name: slot0_toggle

fields.description: Slot 0 12-byte record tag at record offset +4. FUN_08011a00 requires all 12 bytes to match the expected record tag before accepting the slot. Blank (0xFF) on a fresh cart.
fields.evidence: FUN_08011a00 compares 12 bytes at slot base +4 against the expected record tag byte-for-byte and rejects the slot on the first mismatch.
fields.name: slot0_record_tag

fields.description: Slot 0 stored record checksum (u32 at record offset +0x10). FUN_08011a00 accepts the slot only when this value equals the byte-sum of the 0xE0-byte data area. Represented as a plain u32 field because the covered data window is not pinned to a Schema v2 algorithm; see SPEC.md.
fields.evidence: FUN_08011a00 accumulates a byte-sum over 0xE0 data bytes and requires it to equal the u32 at slot base +0x10 before loading the slot payload.
fields.name: slot0_record_checksum

fields.description: Slot 0 record data area at record offset +0x14 through the end of the 30-block slot (220 bytes). FUN_08011a00 copies 0x6A units from this area into game state once tag and checksum verify. Blank (0xFF) on a fresh cart.
fields.evidence: FUN_08011a00 copies 0x6A units from slot base +0x14 into the load destination via FUN_080353e0 (SWI CpuSet) after the tag and checksum checks pass.
fields.name: slot0_payload

fields.description: Slot 1 toggle byte at record offset +1. Same update rule as slot0_toggle, applied to whichever slot validates. Blank (0xFF) on a fresh cart.
fields.evidence: FUN_08011a00 slot-validation path reads the byte at slot base +1, computes (value+1) with wrap to 0 when above 1, and writes it into the header dword copy.
fields.name: slot1_toggle

fields.description: Slot 1 12-byte record tag at record offset +4, validated exactly like slot0_record_tag. Blank (0xFF) on a fresh cart.
fields.evidence: FUN_08011a00 compares 12 bytes at slot base +4 against the expected record tag byte-for-byte and rejects the slot on the first mismatch.
fields.name: slot1_record_tag

fields.description: Slot 1 stored record checksum (u32 at record offset +0x10), validated exactly like slot0_record_checksum. See SPEC.md for the custom sum formula.
fields.evidence: FUN_08011a00 accumulates a byte-sum over 0xE0 data bytes and requires it to equal the u32 at slot base +0x10 before loading the slot payload.
fields.name: slot1_record_checksum

fields.description: Slot 1 record data area at record offset +0x14 through the end of the 30-block slot (220 bytes), loaded exactly like slot0_payload. Blank (0xFF) on a fresh cart.
fields.evidence: FUN_08011a00 copies 0x6A units from slot base +0x14 into the load destination via FUN_080353e0 (SWI CpuSet) after the tag and checksum checks pass.
fields.name: slot1_payload

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'BA0C': first 4 bytes of the 12-byte header validation stamp in the rev8 logical domain
